2609.28085.title: Curriculum Learning with GNN-based Reinforcement Learning for Job Shop Scheduling
2609.28085.paper_summary: The job shop scheduling problem is a challenging combinatorial optimization problem, and recent reinforcement learning approaches using graph neural networks have shown promise for learning scheduling policies directly from problem instances. However, training on large instances remains computationally expensive, and generalization across instance sizes remains challenging. This paper studies curriculum learning for graph neural network-based reinforcement learning in the job shop scheduling problem by comparing it with single-size training across three target sizes: 20 x 20, 25 x 25, and 30 x 30. In the curriculum setting, the policy is first trained on smaller instances and then progressively adapted to larger target sizes, allowing scheduling behavior learned in earlier stages to support learning on larger instances. Models are evaluated on unseen instances from 8 x 8 to 30 x 30 using the optimality gap, considering both generalization across all evaluation sizes and specialization on the target size. Results show that curriculum learning consistently reduces wall-clock training time, with larger benefits as the target size increases. The strongest advantage is observed at 30 x 30, where curriculum learning reduces the mean optimality gap across all evaluation sizes by approximately 8.1 percentage points, reduces the target-size mean optimality gap by approximately 8.6 percentage points, and saves approximately 50 hours of training time.
2609.28085.paper_summary_zh: 工作車間排程問題是一個具有挑戰性的組合優化問題，最近使用圖神經網絡的強化學習方法在直接從問題實例中學習排程策略方面顯示出潛力。<lb/>然而，對於大型實例的訓練仍然計算上昂貴，並且在實例大小之間的泛化仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>本文通過將其與三個目標大小（20 x 20、25 x 25 和 30 x 30）之間的單一大小訓練進行比較，研究了基於圖神經網絡的強化學習在工作車間排程問題中的課程學習。<lb/>在課程設置中，策略首先在較小的實例上進行訓練，然後逐步適應較大的目標大小，允許在早期階段學習的排程行為支持在較大實例上的學習。<lb/>模型在從 8 x 8 到 30 x 30 的未見實例上進行評估，使用最優性差距，考慮到所有評估大小的泛化和在目標大小上的專門化。<lb/>結果顯示，課程學習始終減少了牆鐘訓練時間，隨著目標大小的增加，效益更大。<lb/>在 30 x 30 時觀察到最強的優勢，課程學習將所有評估大小的平均最優性差距減少了約 8.1 個百分點，將目標大小的平均最優性差距減少了約 8.6 個百分點，並節省了約 50 小時的訓練時間。
